headline: Waist- to chest-high windswell on a workable angle — morning log session.
today: Better angle than Rockaway today and a touch more size, but it's still short-period S windswell so keep expectations in check. Dawn cross is the cleanest before the WSW goes cross-on midmorning and drifts onshore by evening — surf the early window around the 9:48 low. Log or fish will do the work.

daysToWatch.note: Similar waist-high fun with a morning window before S onshore ramps up in the evening. Early is the move.
Drops under 2ft with onshore wind — the fun window closes here and it stays small through the week.
